steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; node --version

steps.name: restore-fixes
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git apply /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/matrixhub/checkpoints/20260906-fix-frontend-quality-debt-v3/1788670596080693000-task-exit/tracked.patch; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/helpers/quality_node26_patch.py > /tmp/matrixhub-quality-patch.py; python3 /tmp/matrixhub-quality-patch.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: prepare
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts; npx prettier --write project.inlang/.meta.json project.inlang/README.md scripts/run-vitest.mjs; cd ..; git diff --check

steps.name: focused-tests
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; node ./scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/lib/stores/theme.test.svelte.ts src/lib/stores/user.test.ts src/lib/stores/system/parsers.test.ts

steps.name: frontend-quality
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm run quality:frontend

steps.name: commit-and-push
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git diff --check; git add interface/package.json interface/scripts/run-vitest.mjs interface/src/lib/storage.svelte.ts interface/src/routes/charts/components/DateSelector.svelte interface/src/lib/features/gpio/gpioModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/power/powerConfigModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/matrix/matrixNavigation.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/matrix/matrixModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/usb/terminal/usbTerminalCommandPresets.ts interface/src/lib/features/usb/terminal/useUsbTerminalQuickScripts.svelte.ts; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Fix frontend quality debt'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
